Four controlled direct-PD trials (population_fit=direct, outcome_fit=direct) prove daytime dietary protein/LNAA intake worsens daily OFF time (Barichella 2006 p<0.0001, Tsui 1989, Carter 1989, Eriksson 1988), directly bridged to plain dairy kefir (~8 g dairy protein/cup) via human fermented-dairy postprandial plasma LNAA/BCAA crossover RCTs (Pimentel 2018, Brown 2023, Milan 2024, Burke 2012).
